8.3.22 EthTrcv_MacSecResetRxSc
[SWS_EthTrcv_91028] Definition of API function EthTrcv_MacSecResetRxSc
Status: DRAFT
⌈
Service Name
EthTrcv_MacSecResetRxSc (draft)
Syntax
Std_ReturnType EthTrcv_MacSecResetRxSc (
uint8 TrcvIdx,
uint64 RxSci
)
Service ID [hex]
0x1b
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant for different TrcvIdx, non reentrant for the same TrcvIdx
TrcvIdx
Index of the Ethernet transceiver within the context of the
Ethernet Transceiver Driver
Parameters (in)
RxSci
Secure Channel Identifier for the MACsec’s Reception Secure
channel
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: The request has been accepted E_NOT_OK: The request
has not been accepted
Description
Requests the Ethernet Transceiver Driver to reset to default the MACsec values of the
Reception Secure Channel for the given Secure Channel Identifier.
Tags: atp.Status=draft
Available via
EthTrcv.h
⌋
